About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
Collaborate closely with partner studios on the development of their AAA games
Help define, strengthen, and protect the creative vision, gameplay pillars, and player promise of each project
Provide creative insight, strategic direction, and actionable feedback to design and leadership teams
Identify opportunities to strengthen both individual projects and the broader portfolio of partner studio games
Identify creative risks early, and help teams navigate practical trade-offs
Contribute hands-on to game design work when needed, supporting teams directly on key challenges or opportunities
Mentor design leadership and help raise the overall quality bar across partner teams
Travel regularly to meet and work with teams across Europe, building strong partnerships and identifying where support can have the greatest impact

Who We Look For
10+ years of experience in game development
3+ years in a creative senior leadership role, such as Lead Designer, Creative Director, Game Director, or equivalent
2+ shipped AAA PC and Console shooter or action games
Strong experience on at least one shipped online, multiplayer, or live-service title
Deep understanding of multiplayer systems design across PvP, PvE, and co-op
Strong knowledge of game economies and monetization models, including free-to-play, battle passes, and live-service content strategies
Proven ability to operate at both strategic vision level and hands-on execution level
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across multidisciplinary teams and senior leadership
Ability to give clear creative direction while balancing player experience, production realities, and business goals
Ability to provide clear, constructive, and actionable feedback without becoming overly abstract or theoretical
Willingness to travel and collaborate directly with partner studios across Europe

Poland-Warsaw
